summary: Full frontend visual/functional regression of the NEW Endfield UI/UX redesign (Signal Yellow theme, 84px slim sidebar with hover-expand, bento hero, big typography). Verified: login (PIN 123456), wrong-PIN error, boot overlay hides, desktop 1920x1080 sidebar collapsed 84px / hover expands to 272px, all 6 utility overlays open+close (accountManager, diagnostics, history, tokenHealth, settingsCenter, connectAccount), notification panel toggle+Escape close, theme toggle (dark<->light) persists via localStorage endfield_theme, account-mini rows render with single-letter avatars + names (4 accounts loaded from GAS), summaryAccountsOnline=4/4, profile data populated (Anashin Lv.60, Energi 20%, progress bars), account switch changes #profileName, logout returns to login layer. Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow on login (390) or dashboard (390); #mobileMenuButton opens sidebar drawer (labels visible), #sidebarCloseButton closes; .mobile-bottom-nav visible with 5 items; #bottomSettings opens settings overlay. Only issue found: #bottomAlerts does not open the notification panel due to event propagation bug.

ui_bugs.issue: #bottomAlerts click opens then instantly closes the notification panel. The handler calls toggleNotificationPanel(true) but does not stopPropagation, so the document-level click listener (dashboard.js line 2240-2247) that auto-closes the panel on any outside click fires on the same event and toggles it back to hidden. Result: notification panel unreachable from mobile bottom nav.

action_items: Fix #bottomAlerts handler at /app/dashboard.js:5331 — wrap in `(event) => { event.stopPropagation(); toggleNotificationPanel(true); }` (same pattern as #notificationButton at line 2205-2212). Same fix likely needed on any other bottom-nav buttons that should toggle the notification panel.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard.js is 5601 lines — well past the 700-line guideline; consider splitting notification, sidebar, overlays, GAS-client modules.

Document-level click closer for notification panel is fragile — anywhere new UI is added that opens the panel must remember to stopPropagation. Consider using a dedicated toggle guard (mousedown target check against panel + trigger buttons) instead of relying on stopPropagation at every call site.

The static app relies on Cloudflare Insights beacon which is blocked by the current CSP (script-src). Either add static.cloudflareinsights.com to CSP or remove the beacon tag to clean up console noise.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (1 minor bug on mobile bottom-nav notification toggle)

context_for_next_testing_agent: New CSS/UI redesign works well overall. Boot overlay ~3s. Wait ~10-15s after login for GAS data. Toasts appear bottom-right and can be dismissed via .toast-close. Sidebar hover-expand uses CSS :hover — always hover #sidebar before clicking rail buttons in Playwright. Mobile drawer opens with #mobileMenuButton and #sidebar.open class. To re-verify the notification-panel fix on mobile, click #bottomAlerts once and assert `document.getElementById('notificationPanel').hidden === false`.
rca of the issue: BUG: Notification panel unreachable from mobile bottom-nav. RCA: dashboard.js line 5331 binds `$('#bottomAlerts').addEventListener('click', () => toggleNotificationPanel(true))`. The document-level click listener at line 2240 blindly closes the panel whenever `state.notificationPanelOpen` is true. During the same click, JS sets state.notificationPanelOpen=true (line 1921) and unhides the panel; the event then bubbles to `document`, which sees the flag true and calls toggleNotificationPanel(false), re-hiding it. The equivalent handler on #notificationButton (line 2208-2211) uses `event.stopPropagation()` to prevent this — the mobile equivalent is missing. Reproduction: viewport 390x844, PIN login, wait for data, click #bottomAlerts → panel briefly appears then hides (hidden=true). Mitigation: change line 5331 to `$('#bottomAlerts').addEventListener('click', (event) => { event.stopPropagation(); toggleNotificationPanel(true); });`.
